entries.title: What is Barnes & Noble’s Bargain Basement?
entries.summary: Barnes & Noble's "Bargain Basement" most commonly refers to its discounted book and eBook sections—including its Book Annex, Bargain Books hub, and Nook eBook bargain deals—as well as occasional physical store basements or outlet. The post What is Barnes & Noble’s Bargain Basement? first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
Barnes & Noble’s Bargain Basement typically refers to the heavily discounted digital titles featured in the Barnes & Noble e-book Deals. It also includes steep markdowns—or their general clearance and overstock sections for physical books.

Barnes & Noble’s Bargain Basement is the retailer’s eBook Deals hub—offering strong value for patient digital readers looking to pad their libraries on a budget. Rather than feeling strictly like a dumping ground for obscure titles, the rotating digital catalog regularly surfaces recognizable backlist hits, multi-book collections, and mainstream non-fiction marked down between $0.99 and $3.99. A standout advantage of B&N’s online promotions is that many deals stay active for several weeks rather than expiring within hours, giving shoppers plenty of time to browse across genres without rush.

However, it is important to note that B&N’s Premium Membership 10% discount excludes e-books in the Deals Basement and clearance items can vary wildly by stock. When it comes right down to it, the Deals section ultimately stands out as the far more consistent and rewarding bargain hunt for people who want to save some money.

entries.title: What are the best Bluetooth Page-Turners for e-readers?
entries.summary: There are dozens of Bluetooth Page-Turn remotes for e-readers such as Kindle, Kobo, and Onyx Boox, as well as for Musicians. These are the best ones, as chosen by the Good e-Reader editors. The post What are the best Bluetooth Page-Turners for e-readers? first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
The best Bluetooth page-turners depend on whether you need a handheld remote for e-readers or a hands-free foot pedal for sheet music. Native remotes eliminate screen clips for modern Kindles, Kobos, and Boox tablets, while silent foot pedals dominate live performances.

Best Kindle Remotes

Amazon Kindle Clip

Introducing All-New Amazon Kindle Click — Bluetooth Page-Turner Remote for Kindle Devices...

  • Turn pages without reaching for your Kindle – Compatible with all Kindle devices (2024 Release and Onward). Pairs over Bluetooth so you turn pages forward and back while your Kindle stays in place.
  • Brightness and sleep control at your fingertips – Dedicated side buttons let you adjust the screen brightness without opening a menu. Press both to put your Kindle to sleep without reaching for it.
  • Rechargeable battery that lasts for weeks – Read for weeks on a single charge, then recharge over USB-C. (USB-C cable and adapter sold separately.)

Reviewers generally praise the Amazon Kindle Click (often referred to as the “clip-free” remote) as a worthwhile upgrade over traditional third-party screen clips because it pairs directly via Bluetooth without blocking your margins, works regardless of case thickness, and includes dedicated buttons for turning pages both forward and backward, adjusting brightness, and putting the device to sleep. However, critics and users note a few notable drawbacks: it’s limited to 2024 and newer Kindle models, its physical buttons produce noticeably loud clicks in quiet rooms, it lacks warm-light color temperature controls, and it doesn’t include a USB-C charging cable in the box.

SK SYUKUYU RF Remote Control Page Turner

SK SYUKUYU RF Remote Control Page Turner for Kindle Reading Ipad Surface Comics, iPhone Android...

  • 【One for All】Suitable for capacitive screen devices, Kindle page turner(Except Kindle 8th Gen 2016, Kindle touch 2011), iPhone page turner, iPad page turner, Android tablets page turner
  • 【Reading more freely】Release your hands and make Reading more freely
  • 【Easy】Clip it when you use it,Take it off when not in use. The remote control is controlled by one hand, delicate and compact, comfortable to feel

The SK SYUKUYU RF Remote Control Page Turner is one of the most popular third-party page turners among Kindle readers, widely used by readers for its effortless setup without Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, ergonomic handheld clicker, reliable range, and multi-week USB-C battery life across virtually any touchscreen e-reader or tablet. However, users on Reddit’s r/kindle and reviewers point out several trade-offs: it can only turn pages forward (unless you buy a second clip), the receiver automatically goes into sleep mode after roughly 5 to 8 minutes of inactivity (which can annoy slower readers), and the bulky clip can cover edge text unless you widen your Kindle’s page margins—along with occasional quality-control complaints about units failing after a few months.

For Kobo

Kobo Remote

Kobo Remote, Page Turner for Kobo eReaders, White | Hands-Free Reading, Ergonomic, Bluetooth...

  • 𝗘𝗙𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗟𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗣𝗔𝗚𝗘 𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗡𝗜𝗡𝗚 - Turn pages with a simple click using Kobo Remote, designed exclusively for your Kobo eReader. Stay immersed in your story without swiping or tapping
  • 𝗦𝗘𝗔𝗠𝗟𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗪𝗜𝗥𝗘𝗟𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗣𝗔𝗜𝗥𝗜𝗡𝗚 - Connect easily over Bluetooth with a single button press, making setup quick and ensures a reliable connection every time you read
  • 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗕𝗟𝗘 & 𝗖𝗟𝗜𝗣-𝗙𝗥𝗘𝗘 𝗗𝗘𝗦𝗜𝗚𝗡 - A top eReader accessories pick, Kobo Remote’s ergonomic shape fits naturally in your hand, the clip-free design gives you an unobstructed view for distraction-free reading

The Kobo Remote is a lightweight curved Bluetooth page-turner that connects directly to compatible Kobo e-readers without requiring a screen clip, making hands-free reading in bed or on a stand seamless. Reviewers at The Verge and Android Authority praise its comfortable palm-sized grip, easy pairing, and multi-month battery life from a single replaceable AAA battery, while noting its simple two-button layout (next and previous page, or 30-second audiobook skips) lacks customization, can sound slightly clicky in quiet rooms, and may keep Wi-Fi active or drain extra e-reader battery over Bluetooth. Meanwhile, Good e-Reader highlights its first-party convenience and sleep/wake readiness, and Reddit forum discussions show mixed opinions on reliably switching between multiple Kobo devices.

8bitdo micro

8Bitdo Micro Bluetooth Gamepad Pocket-sized Mini Controller for Switch/Switch 2, Android, and...

  • Weighs 24.8 grams featuring 16 buttons. Ultra-portable and versatile.
  • Made for 2D games

The 8BitDo Micro is a featherweight (~25g), keychain-sized Bluetooth controller with 16 programmable buttons and a USB-C rechargeable battery that doubles as a popular, budget-friendly e-reader page-turner. Readers highlight its versatility across retro 2D gaming, digital art shortcuts, and clipless page turning via the 8BitDo Ultimate Software mobile app’s Keyboard mode, offering roughly 10–12 hours of battery life per charge. On the downside, Reddit users note that 16 tiny buttons can feel overly complex and cause hand cramps during long reading sessions compared to a dedicated page-turner. Kobo devices require manually re-enabling Bluetooth to reconnect after powering down.

For Onyx Boox

Boox Tappy

BOOX Tappy Bluetooth Remoter Wireless Page Turner

  • Tappy Bluetooth Remoter

The BOOX Tappy is a lightweight, retro typewriter-inspired Bluetooth page-turner with two tactile, swappable keycaps, USB-C charging, and multi-week battery life. Reviewers at The Verge and eWritable praise its sturdy build, fidget-friendly button travel, and three-mode versatility—switching between Reading (page turns), Browsing (vertical scrolling), and Multimedia (track/audiobook controls)—with full button customization on BOOX devices running Firmware V4.2 or later. However, it is important to note it does not turn pages on Kindle or Kobo e-readers (working primarily with BOOX and standard Android/iOS volume-mapping apps), while The Verge points out its boxy shape is less ergonomic in the hand than curved remotes, and users on Reddit have mixed opinions on its value given its niche compatibility.

MITER Remote

Bluetooth Remote Control Page Turner Clicker for Boox, e-Reader, TikTok Scrolling, YouTube Shorts...

  • 【Remote Page Turner for Bluetooth e-Reader】 With Remote Page Turner, you no longer need to touch the screen to turn ebook pages. This hands-free e-book Page Turner lets you completely immerse yourself in reading comfortably. This remote controller also has a Page Refresh button to provide a clean reading screen. (*All operations may vary depending on the device manufacturer or the specific App.) (*This remote control is Not compatible with Kindle Paperwhite, Oasis, Colorsoft, Scribe, Voyage) (This remote works well with Kindle application on iPad, iPhone, Galaxy, and Andorid OS tablets phones)
  • 【Remote Scrolling Clicker for TikTok&YouTube Shorts】 The latest remote control with new technology allows you to scroll Tiktok&YouTube Shorts remotely. No need to touch the screen to turn the next last video, volume -+, Pause Play, and send a like. Free your hands. you can watch TikTok/YouTube videos comfortably while lying on the sofa. (Note for iOS Enable AssistiveTouch under Settings > Accessibility > Touch. for Android ONE UI 7.0 above Settings > General > Mouse&Trackpad > Pointer Speed and Adjust the speed using the Slow-Fast slider) (On TikTok Shorts Reels, double click the volume key button to go next video, double click the play button to pause, long press play button to send a like)
  • 【Bluetooth Multi-Pairing up to 3 Devices】 No longer need to buy multiple remote controllers. With a Multi-paring function, it is easy to switch between up to 3 devices including your tablet, phone and e-reader. Simple one-click button to control multiple devices with just one remote controller.

The MITER Bluetooth Remote Control (often sold in a Bluetooth-only model or a dual Bluetooth + RF version) is widely praised by Onyx Boox users as one of the most capable and ergonomic third-party page-turners available. Because Boox tablets run on Android, they take full advantage of the remote’s multi-button layout beyond simple forward and backward page turns.

For Musicians

AirTurn DUO 500 Silent Bluetooth Pedal Controller

AirTurn PED 500 Portable Bluetooth Pedal Page Turner | Compatible with with iPad, Android, Works...

  • TURN PAGES HANDS-FREE WITH A TAP: Keep your hands on your instrument and your eyes on the music. Just tap your foot to instantly advance or rewind pages.
  • SLIM, LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN FITS NEARLY ANY GIG BAG: Less than half an inch thin and ultra-portable, the PED 500 travels effortlessly from rehearsal to stage and beyond.
  • QUIET, TACTILE PEDAL FEEL BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE: Quiet enough for studio sessions, with just enough feedback to confirm every command without distraction.

The AirTurn DUO 500 is a rugged, two-pedal Bluetooth controller designed primarily for musicians, presenters, and readers who want completely silent, hands-free page turns or app control. It builds on the older BT200 model with Bluetooth 5 for faster range and response, USB-C charging, and a removable center transceiver that can also be detached and used as a handheld remote.

PageFlip Butterfly Bluetooth Page-turning Pedal

PageFlip Firefly Bluetooth Page Turner Pedal – Programmable, Illuminated | Foot Pedal for iPad...

  • HANDS-FREE PAGE TURNING WITH LED PEDALS: This bluetooth page turner pedal lets you flip pages silently and hands-free. Illuminated pedals offer perfect visibility in dark venues. Ideal ipad foot pedal for musicians performing live or in low light.
  • UNIVERSAL APP & DEVICE COMPATIBILITY: Works with iPad, Android, Mac, Windows & Linux. This ipad page turner foot pedal supports forScore, MobileSheets, OnSong & more via Bluetooth or USB-C – your perfect wireless page turner solution.
  • FULLY PROGRAMMABLE FOR PERSONALIZED CONTROL: Customize both pedals with 5 preset modes or assign hotkeys via our software. Whether you need arrow keys, mouse clicks or page turns, this bluetooth page turner for ipad adapts to your setup.

The PageFlip Butterfly is a sturdy, entry-level dual foot pedal designed for simple, silent, hands-free page turning on tablets, computers, and Android e-readers. Rather than relying on custom software or rechargeable internal cells, it keeps things straightforward with physical mode switches and standard AA batteries.

AirTurn Cue

AirTurn BT500S-6 Bluetooth Pedal Page Turner | DAW MIDI App Controller (Expression Pedal Not...

  • PERFORMANCE: Offers 200+ feet of wireless range, and 200+ hours of use with each battery charge. 2-year coverage with product registration (includes battery).
  • ENDLESS APPS: Hundreds of compatible apps for turning pages, teleprompting, reading music, scrolling lyrics and tabs, triggering backing tracks and effects, sending MIDI commands, cueing audio and lighting, capturing photo and video, live streaming, plus so much more! (Some may be default on your device and others are available in your app store.)
  • VERSATILE: Pedal board compatible with optional 9v supply. Create commands for almost any app that responds to keystrokes, macros, mouse clicks, or MIDI with the free AirTurn Manager.

The AirTurn Cue is a lightweight, wrist-mounted Bluetooth page-turner built for musicians, conductors, and readers who want discreet, hands-free page control without using a floor pedal. Featuring a sweat-resistant polymer housing, low-profile backlit buttons, and Bluetooth 5 with over 200 feet of range, it lets you advance digital sheet music or e-books with a quick tap on your wrist or instrument stand.

entries.title: Vivlio One-O is a new e-reader released in France
entries.summary: The Vivlio One-O was officially released in early November 2026 as a special limited-edition holiday follow-up to the original 2025 Vivlio One e-reader. The post Vivlio One-O is a new e-reader released in France first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
The Vivlio One-O is a lightweight, budget-friendly 6-inch e-reader released in November 2026 as a splash-resistant follow-up to the original Vivlio One. Designed in France as an ultra-simple reading device, it focuses strictly on core e-book reading without extra multimedia features.

The Vivlio One-O stands out as one of the lightest and most affordable 6-inch e-readers on the market, refining its predecessor with IPX4 splash resistance and a magnetic sleep cover. Weighing just 150 grams with a matte grey finish, itis easy to hold one-handed during long reading sessions. Reviewers and users on sites like Liseuse.biz and Liseuses.net praise its crisp text rendering—which punches above its 212 dpi spec thanks to custom font smoothing—alongside its warm-light blue-light filter, responsive page turns, and generous 16 GB of storage.

However, hitting its aggressive €89.99 price point requires notable software and hardware trade-offs. Built around Vivlio’s stripped-down in-house operating system, the device lacks physical page-turn buttons, audiobook support, PDF rendering, and Adobe DRM compatibility, restricting readers primarily to standard EPUBs, LCP library loans, and purchases from Vivlio or partner stores like E.Leclerc. Overall, it is an unbeatable value for casual novel readers seeking a distraction-free, pocket-sized e-reader, though power users who need multi-format flexibility will want to look higher up Vivlio’s lineup.

entries.title: Convert PDF to EPUB with Convertio: A Simple Way to Make Digital Books Easier to Read
entries.summary: Convertio simplifies the conversion process by providing an online platform where users can upload documents, select an output format, and download the finished file. With a few simple steps and a quick review afterward, readers can prepare suitable PDF documents for a more flexible digital reading experience. The post Convert PDF to EPUB with Convertio: A Simple Way to Make Digital Books Easier t
entries.content:
Reading a lengthy PDF on a phone or e-reader is not always convenient. The pages may be designed for a computer screen or printed paper, which means readers often need to zoom in and move around the document to follow the text. EPUB offers a more flexible reading experience because its content can adjust to the dimensions of different screens.

Convertio makes this format change accessible through a browser-based service. Its convert pdf to epub tool allows users to upload a PDF, select EPUB as the output format, and download the converted e-book without installing dedicated conversion software.

Whether someone is organizing personal reading materials, preparing educational documents, or creating a more convenient digital library, understanding the conversion process can help make the experience smoother.

Table of Contents

  • Why PDF and EPUB Work Differently
  • When Should You Convert PDF to EPUB?
  • How to Convert a PDF Using Convertio
  • What Makes EPUB Useful for Digital Reading?
  • Common Conversion Problems
  • Choosing the Right Format for Your Documents
  • Tips for Maintaining a Digital Book Collection
  • Conclusion

1. Why PDF and EPUB Work Differently

PDF and EPUB are both popular document formats, but they were designed with different priorities.

PDF focuses on preserving the original appearance of a document. Text, images, tables, and other elements remain positioned within fixed pages. This is useful for documents that need to look consistent when opened on different devices.

EPUB focuses on digital publications. Its reflowable content can adjust to different screen dimensions, allowing readers to customize their reading experience.

The following table highlights their main differences:

Feature EPUB
Page arrangement Fixed Usually reflowable
Screen adjustment Limited Flexible
Font customization Reader-dependent Commonly available
Mobile reading May require zooming Often more convenient
Main purpose Document sharing Digital publications
Navigation Pages and bookmarks Chapters and navigation menus

According to the W3C EPUB 3.3 specification, EPUB supports structured digital publications with different presentation possibilities, including reflowable and fixed-layout content.

2. When Should You Convert PDF to EPUB?

Not every PDF needs to become an EPUB file. The conversion is most useful when the document is primarily intended for reading rather than preserving an exact page design.

Here are some practical examples:

  • Long books: Readers can enjoy novels and other lengthy publications with adjustable text.
  • Study materials: Students can keep reading resources in compatible e-book applications.
  • Travel reading: EPUB files can make reading more comfortable on supported mobile devices.
  • Digital collections: Converting suitable documents makes it easier to organize different publications together.
  • Personal reading preferences: Compatible applications may allow adjustments to fonts, margins, and backgrounds.

For instance, someone who regularly reads books on a smartphone may find EPUB more practical than PDF because the text can adapt to the available display space.

However, documents containing complex diagrams, detailed tables, or mathematical formulas may need additional review after conversion.

3. How to Convert a PDF Using Convertio

Convertio provides a straightforward online process for converting PDF documents into EPUB files. Users can access the service through a browser and upload documents from different sources, including a computer, Google Drive, Dropbox, or a direct URL.

Convertio

Follow these steps to complete the conversion:

Step 1: Open the Convertio website

Visit the PDF to EPUB converter page and locate the file upload option.

Step 2: Select your PDF document

Click the file selection button and choose the document you want to convert. You can also drag and drop a supported file onto the page.

Step 3: Choose EPUB as the output

Check the available output formats and select EPUB.

Step 4: Start the conversion

Click the Convert button to begin processing. The service handles the conversion using its cloud infrastructure.

Step 5: Download your converted document

Once the process is complete, download the EPUB file and open it in a compatible reading application.

The process does not require users to install a separate desktop conversion program. Convertio also supports multiple file formats beyond PDF and EPUB, making it useful for different document-related tasks.

File Converter+1

4. What Makes EPUB Useful for Digital Reading?

One of the biggest advantages of EPUB is its ability to adapt content to different reading environments.

Instead of displaying every page as a fixed image, a reflowable EPUB can rearrange text according to the screen dimensions and reader preferences.

Some useful features include:

  • Adjustable font sizes: Readers can enlarge or reduce text using compatible applications.
  • Flexible layouts: Text can adapt to smartphones, tablets, and supported e-readers.
  • Chapter navigation: Properly structured publications can include navigation menus and chapter divisions.
  • Reading customization: Supported applications may offer different fonts, margins, and background colors.
  • Convenient storage: Multiple publications can be maintained in a digital library.

EPUB is supported by many reading applications and devices, including Apple Books and Kobo. However, Kindle devices have different format requirements, so compatibility should be checked before transferring a converted document.

Convertio

5. Common Conversion Problems

A successful conversion does not always mean that the resulting document will look identical to the original PDF. Different document structures can produce different results.

The following table explains some common situations and what readers should check.

Problem Possible explanation Recommended action
Missing text PDF contains scanned images Check whether OCR is required
Incorrect spacing Original formatting is complex Review paragraph arrangement
Missing illustrations Image placement was complicated Compare with the original
Disorganized chapters Document lacks clear structure Check headings and navigation
Incorrect symbols Font compatibility issue Review special characters
Difficult-to-read tables Fixed-layout elements Compare table information

For scanned documents, Optical Character Recognition (OCR) can identify text within images. Convertio offers a separate OCR tool for supported file types.

developers.convertio.co

Important tip

Always keep the original PDF until you have checked the converted EPUB. This makes it easier to identify missing information, formatting differences, or other conversion issues.

6. Choosing the Right Format for Your Documents

PDF and EPUB are not competing formats for exactly the same purpose. Each works better in particular situations.

Document type or activity Better choice
Business reports
Official forms
Digital novels EPUB
Long reading materials EPUB
Documents requiring original formatting
Personal e-book collections EPUB
Documents with complex page layouts

If preserving the original design is important, PDF is usually the more suitable option. If comfortable reading and adjustable text are the main priorities, EPUB may be preferable.

7. Tips for Maintaining a Digital Book Collection

Once documents have been converted, organizing them properly can make a digital library easier to maintain.

Here are a few useful suggestions:

  • Create separate folders: Organize books by subject, author, or category.
  • Use meaningful filenames: Include the book title or publication name instead of generic file names.
  • Check document quality: Open converted files to make sure their content is complete.
  • Choose compatible applications: Use an e-book reader that supports EPUB files.
  • Keep backups: Store important original documents separately.
  • Review file permissions: Make sure you have permission to convert and store copyrighted publications.

These small habits can make managing a growing collection of digital publications much easier.

8. Conclusion

Converting PDF documents into EPUB can be a practical choice for readers who want greater flexibility when accessing digital publications. The two formats serve different purposes: PDF preserves the original page arrangement, while EPUB makes it possible for text to adapt to different screens.

Convertio simplifies the conversion process by providing an online platform where users can upload documents, select an output format, and download the finished file. With a few simple steps and a quick review afterward, readers can prepare suitable PDF documents for a more flexible digital reading experience.

entries.title: Amazon Kindle has a new Tag system that replaced Collections
entries.summary: Amazon recently updated Kindle e-readers to replace traditional Collection folders with "Tags" directly in the Library view. Your existing collections automatically convert into tags containing all the same books. The post Amazon Kindle has a new Tag system that replaced Collections first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
Amazon released the 5.20.2.0.1 update a couple of weeks ago, but their website didn’t include a changelog to show what new features this firmware brings to any Kindle made after 2024. The company has just posted the information, so we now know everything.

One of the most controversial aspects of this new update is the changes to collections. Amazon is renaming Collections to Tags on Kindle E-Readers. Your existing collections stay intact with all the same books and documents, and changes sync across devices. On non-e-reader apps like Kindle for Windows and Mac, they continue to appear as Collections.

On the new Tags interface: Look near the top of your Library screen rather than inside the standard sort/view menu, then select All tags to browse your tag folders. If your device still has collections, open your library, tap the sort/view icon in the upper-right corner, and choose Collections. If tags or collections don’t appear right away: Sync your Kindle, exit and reopen Library, or check Settings > Home and Library to confirm how collections/tags are displayed.

Version 5.20.2.0.1 – October 2026

Here’s what’s new:

Ask This Book: Book search now includes Ask This Book, a conversational AI assistant that enables you to ask questions about your English-language Kindle book while you are reading it, without revealing spoilers.

Web browser: Webpages now render more accurately. Feature updates include a new home screen with your pinned favorites, a unified search bar for search and web addresses, and an option to select your default search engine.

“Auto-snap shapes” toggle in notebooks: Control whether holding at the end of a stroke snaps your hand-drawn shapes into clean geometric forms.

What Kindle e-readers get the new software?

  • Kindle Scribe – 3rd Generation
  • Kindle Scribe (without Front Light)
  • Kindle Scribe Colorsoft (1st Generation)
  • Kindle Scribe – 2024 Release
  • Kindle Scribe – 2022 Release
  • Kindle Colorsoft (1st Generation)
  • Kindle Paperwhite (12th Generation) – 2024 Release
  • Kindle (11th Generation) – 2024 Release
  • Kindle (2026 release)
  • Kindle (Aluminum – 2026 release)
  • Kindle Paperwhite (2026 release) and Amazon Kids Kindle Paperwhite (2026 release)
  • Kindle Colorsoft (2026 release) and Amazon Kids Kindle Colorsoft (2026 release)

entries.title: Kindle Colorsoft 2024 Signature Edition vs Kindle Colorsoft 2026
entries.summary: The 2026 plastic Kindle Colorsoft improves on the original 2024 model with a thinner, lighter squared-off body, a user-replaceable battery, and an upgraded light guide that fixes early yellow-band screen issues, though it drops from 32GB to 16GB of storage and loses wireless charging and auto-brightness. The post Kindle Colorsoft 2024 Signature Edition vs Kindle Colorsoft 2026 first appeared on Go
entries.content:
The 2026 Kindle Colorsoft 16GB with a Plastic Body is thinner and lighter than the original 2024 Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition, which also has a plastic body. The 2026 model has a user-replaceable battery and a refined display stack—though it drops to 16GB of storage and removes wireless charging.

Built on the 2026 Paperwhite frame, the standard Colorsoft is a full millimeter thinner (6.8 mm) and 15 grams lighter than the 2024 release. According to Good e-Reader, the squared-off edges and relocated top-right power button prevent accidental presses while reading. It also swaps the 2024 rainbow-embossed rear logo for a standard embossed Kindle logo.

Both devices still rely on a 7-inch E Ink Kaleido 3 panel (300 ppi black-and-white, 150 ppi color) rather than moving to Kaleido 4. However, the 2026 model introduces a reworked reverse-stack construction with nitride LEDs, micro-deflectors, and an updated optical coating to improve light uniformity and address the yellow band discoloration seen on early 2024 units.

To comply with EU right-to-repair rules, the 2026 plastic back panel gently pries off from a corner, allowing you to unscrew and swap the battery yourself with a standard Phillips screwdriver.

Because Amazon split the 2026 lineup into a standard plastic tier and an aluminum Signature Edition, choosing the 2026 plastic model means giving up the 2024 model’s 32 GB storage, Qi wireless charging, and ambient auto-adjusting front light for a slimmer chassis and better repairability. (Note: The 2026 plastic model also lacks the magnetic pogo pins required for the new physical Page Turn Cover and charging dock, which are exclusive to the aluminum Signature Edition.)

Feature

2024 Kindle Colorsoft (Signature)

 2026 Kindle Colorsoft (Standard Plastic)
Body & Chassis Plastic with rounded edges Thinner, squared-off plastic
Thickness & Weight 7.8 mm / 219 g (7.7 oz) 6.8 mm / 204 g (7.2 oz)
Power Button Bottom edge Top-right side edge
Display Tech 7″ Kaleido 3 (300/150 ppi) 7″ Kaleido 3 + nitride LEDs & new optical coating
Storage 32 GB 16 GB
Battery Sealed (8 weeks) User-replaceable (8 weeks)
Extras Wireless charging & auto-brightness Manual warm light only (no wireless charging)

Amazon Kindle Colorsoft Signature Edition 32GB (2024 model) – With color display, auto-adjusting...

  • Read in color – The 7" Colorsoft display is high-contrast and easy on the eyes, with paper-like color that brings covers and content to life.
  • Color your pages – Highlight your favorite scenes in yellow, orange, blue, pink, and green
  • Marathon reading – A single charge via USB-C lasts up to 8 weeks, or power up with the wireless charging dock (sold separately).

Amazon Kindle Colorsoft 16GB (2026 model), Now thinner and lighter, 7" color display, Warm light...

  • The new Kindle Colorsoft — Thinner and lighter, with a 7" paper-like color display. New edge-to-edge color, waterproof design, no ads.
  • Color your pages — Paper-like color perfect for comics, graphic novels, and more. Highlight your favorite scenes in yellow, orange, blue, pink, and green.
  • Up to 8 weeks on a single charge — The display only uses power when you turn the page or use the front light.

entries.title: Remarkable Tablets on Sale for Black Friday
entries.summary: For Black Friday 2026, reMarkable is offering $100 off standalone bundles and $300 off its Super Bundle, with deals running from November 19 through December 1, 2026 in North America. The post Remarkable Tablets on Sale for Black Friday first appeared on Good e-Reader.
entries.content:
reMarkable is offering Black Friday bundle discounts of $100 off individual Paper Pro and Paper Pro Move bundles, or $300 off the two-tablet Super Bundle through December 1, 2026. The promotion launched in the US on November 19, 2026, through the reMarkable US Black Friday Store and major US retailers including Best Buy USA and Amazon.com. Standalone tablets without a folio and the monochrome reMarkable Paper Pure are excluded from the Black Friday markdowns.

Reviewers praise the reMarkable Paper Pro Move with Marker Plus and Basalt Book Folio for its pen-on-paper writing feel, crisp 264 PPI color display, and ultra-portable 230g frame, though many criticize its high price, narrow 16:9 aspect ratio, and reliance on a paid subscription for full search and cloud features. This bundle is widely viewed as a strong “sidekick” notebook for meetings, travel, and quick jotting, rather than a standalone replacement for a full-size document reader or multi-purpose tablet.

The reMarkable 2 with Marker Plus and Black Leather Book Folio is an older-generation monochrome paper tablet bundle that is excluded from the official Black Friday sale, though it remains available via third-party retailers and as a $399 USD refurbished bundle directly from reMarkable.

People like the reMarkable Paper Pro with Marker Plus and Black Leather Book Folio for its expansive 11.8-inch color canvas, snappy performance, and tactile pen-on-paper writing feel, though long-term users note trade-offs including muted screen contrast, added weight, edge wear on the leather folio, and a subscription requirement for full cloud features. This flagship bundle is widely regarded as an ideal desk-based digital notebook for annotating full-size PDFs, sketching, and distraction-free writing, rather than a lightweight e-reader or an all-in-one productivity tablet.
